caption_L1: This is a area plot titled Global number of Bosch employees from 2006 to 2019 (in 1,000s). The y-axis plots Number of employees in thousands. A linear scale from 2006 to 2018 can be found along the x-axis, marked Year.
caption_L2L3: The number of employees seems to remain reasonably steady (around 275, 000) between 2006 and 2014, with slight increases in 2008 (approx 280,000) and 2011 (approx 300,000). There is then a steep increase of employees in 2015 to approx 375,000 and following increases in 2016, 2017 and 2018 to approx 380,000 , 400,000 and 410,000 respectively Ely before flattening off in 2019.
